summary: Iteration 6: Full admin hat editor (CRUD + upload + checkout w/ edited price + seed persistence) tested. Backend 13/13 pytest pass (new test_admin_hats.py): upload rejects missing passcode (401) and non-image (400); PNG upload returns /api/files/{path} and public GET returns image/png bytes exactly; POST /api/admin/products validates name/price>0/images>=1 -> 422; duplicate name slug suffix (-2) works; new hat appears in GET /api/products and detail; PUT updates price (123.45->199) and story, persists; checkout for TEST hat creates Stripe cs_test_ session with amount_total=19900 CAD (reflects edited 199.00 price); DELETE requires passcode (401), removes hat, GET returns 404; unknown slug delete 404. Reservation session released after checkout. Seed persistence verified: 6 originals (the-renegade 249, midnight-renegade 249, renegade-red 275, the-outlaw 275, the-wanderer 295, the-shaman 325, all sold=false) untouched. Frontend (desktop 1920): admin login w/ renegade2026, admin-add-hat opens hat-editor, no-photo save shows 'at least one photo' toast; set_input_files uploaded 2 PNGs, photo-right-0 reorder & photo-remove-1 both work; filled name/price/description/story/details (one per line) + saved; TEST UI Hat appeared in admin list, on /shop, product page shows story+details ('ui story','line one'); product-add-to-cart added to cart (nav-cart-count=1); admin-edit-{slug} changed price to 150 and story to 'edited story', verified on product page (price 150 + edited story rendered); admin-delete-{slug} -> admin-delete-dialog -> admin-delete-confirm removed hat. Final cleanup: all TEST hats deleted via DELETE; originals verified unchanged.
critical_code_review_comments: ProductIn.model_dump() in admin_create_product includes 'order': None when not provided but Product model has order default 0 — handled via explicit None check (ok, but could type order as Optional with default_factory for clarity).

admin_update_product writes raw ProductIn fields which lack 'currency' — Product doc preserves currency='CAD' default on new creates; existing docs keep their currency on $set since only fields in ProductIn are set. Fine.
No file size pre-check on frontend before upload; backend enforces 15MB. Low priority UX.
Delete endpoint does not clean up uploaded storage files referenced only by that hat (orphaned files remain). Low priority / cost impact only.
/api/files/{path} is public (no referer or signed URL) — anyone with URL can view. Acceptable for public product photos.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST Hat Alpha (slug test-hat-alpha, test-hat-alpha-2) and TEST UI Hat during tests; ALL deleted via DELETE /api/admin/products/{slug} at test end. Verified cleanup: GET /api/products returns exactly the 6 originals with original prices & sold=false. Uploaded files via /api/admin/upload are left in storage (orphaned) — acceptable, no DB impact.
